I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message. I couldn't confirm the 8 April date.

- Nothing Pree can see has a renewal date for Brackenwater Freight Co. I checked #central-team and the shared files, and the account folder came back empty.
- I didn't record the date anywhere and didn't treat it as fact.
- I pointed her to Marcus Lindqvist. A public note from September 2025 says the account moved to him, and Brackenwater sits with the North team. I suggested she pass the tip to him as unconfirmed so he can check it against the contract.

No approvals were needed, and I didn't send any mail.
